      Problem: The Jinja2 template renders an integer value without ensuring it remains double-quoted in the output if it were unquoted. More importantly, the current implementation in `tests/test_render_validation_templates.py` explicitly asserts that every line in `validate.env` must end with a double-quote (`line.endswith('"')`). Since `manifest.get('port', 8545)` returns an integer, the rendered line will be `ANVIL_PORT=8545`.; The regression test `test_renderer_family_dispatch_routing` (and `test_log9_validate_env_values_are_double_quoted` in the new tests) will fail on the assertion `assert '="' in line and line.endswith('"')`.

      Problem: Removal of the fallback `|| echo 1` in the `app_pid` subshell.; The `|| echo 1` was a defensive measure to allow the test to continue (to the shutdown probe which would then fail descriptively) even if the PID file hadn't been written yet or was inaccessible. With its removal, if `cat` fails or the file is missing, `app_pid` becomes empty. The subsequent check `grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'` will fail, causing the test to exit 1 immediately with "unable to determine app pid", making the test significantly more brittle to startup timing.
